Name: CSX Corporation
Description: CSX Corporation is a leading North American transportation company, primarily engaged in rail transportation services and logistics solutions. Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, CSX operates an extensive network that facilitates the movement of goods across a diverse range of industries. The company is strategically positioned to capitalize on growing demand for efficient and sustainable freight transportation, making it a key player in the logistics and supply chain sectors. Additionally, CSX is focused on leveraging technology to improve operational efficiency and enhance customer service.
